import os
import sys
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["LIGHTGBM_SKIP_TQDM"] = "true"

# Load Data
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_submission_path = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"

try:
    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Error: train.csv not found.")
    sys.exit()

try:
    test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print("Error: test.csv not found.")
    sys.exit()

try:
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)
    col_order = list(sample_df.columns)
    if len(col_order) > 1:
        col_to_use = [c for c in sample_df.columns if c != "Insult"][0]
        col_order = [col_to_use] + [c for c in sample_df.columns if c != col_to_use]
    else:
        col_order = ["Prediction"]
except FileNotFoundError:
    col_order = ["Prediction"]
    print(
        "Warning: sample_submission_null.csv not found, proceeding with standard format."
    )


def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text) or text == "":
        return ""
    text = str(text).strip('"').strip().strip("'").replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ")
    text = text.lower().strip()
    return text if text else ""


# Preprocess Comments
train_df["Comment_Cleaned"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment_Cleaned"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Prepare Training Features
X_train_full = train_df["Comment_Cleaned"]
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values.astype(float)

# Prepare Testing Features
X_test = test_df["Comment_Cleaned"]

# Vectorizer - optimized parameters
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=8000, min_df=2, norm="l2", ngram_range=(1, 2), sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_full)
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test)

# Split TRAINING set into train/val for genuine hold-out estimation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_vec, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Calculate class weights for imbalanced dataset
pos_count = y_train.sum()
neg_count = len(y_train) - pos_count
class_scale = neg_count / pos_count

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "learning_rate": 0.15,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": -1,
    "min_child_samples": 15,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

if class_scale > 1:
    params["scale_pos_weight"] = class_scale

model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_train, y_train)

val_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_predictions)

print(f"Genuine Hold-Out Validation AUC: {val_auc:.4f}")

test_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]

if sample_df is not None and len(sample_df) > 0:
    header = sample_df.columns[0]
    submission_data = sample_df.copy()
    out_col = header if header != "Insult" else "Insult"
    submission_data[out_col] = test_predictions
else:
    submission_data = pd.DataFrame({col_order[0]: test_predictions})

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
submission_data.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
print(f"Total predictions: {len(test_predictions)}")
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC: {val_auc:.4f}")
